verdict.rationale: Poly documents importing existing notes from Notion, Evernote, Obsidian, Bear and more into Poly Mind, and its general file migration preserves folder structure and metadata such as tags. However, nothing confirms that internal links or attachments survive a notes import, and the structure-preservation claims come from file-storage migration, not from the notes importer. Missing for 10: Roam import, documented preservation of links and attachments, structure fidelity for note-app imports specifically, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my existing notes from Notion, Evernote, Roam, or plain Markdown with structure, links, and attachments preserved

citations.quote: Bring existing notes and memory archives into Poly Mind from Notion, Obsidian, Evernote, Bear, and more.
You can drop entire folders, and Poly preserves your folder structure as it uploads. Metadata such as tags and colors are preserved
Poly preserves your folder structure and file metadata, and you can continue working while the import runs.
